entities.name: Ayça Naz İhtiyaroğlu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ayça Naz İhtiyaroğlu is a Turkish volleyball player. She is 169 cm tall and plays as libero. She has been playing for Galatasaray Women's Volleyball Team since the 2009 season and wears number 8. She has played 53 times for the national team. She has also played for Yeşilyurt and Fenerbahçe Acıbadem.
